fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Terrain
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Open Terrain; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to help responders locate the turn-in at night or in reduced visibility.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of parked vehicles so emergency apparatus can reach the residence without stopping.
• Maintain enough vertical clearance along the driveway for a fire engine or ambulance to pass without obstruction from overhanging branches.
• Identify a designated turnaround area near the residence and keep it clear at all times so apparatus is not required to back out the full length of the driveway.
• Post the property address visibly at both the road entrance and again near the main residence to help responders confirm their location after traveling the access drive.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without navigating around obstacles.
• Trim dense vegetation along the sides of the driveway to maintain a clear line of sight for drivers and to allow two vehicles to pass or a single apparatus to maneuver.
• Identify and communicate the single access point limitation to your local fire station so they are aware before an incident occurs.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored equipment or materials that would reduce the available space for staging a responding unit.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Irrigated Landscape; Open Terrain; Brush Area; Brush Area; Long Driveway; Single Access Route; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Ground Vegetation; Woody Debris
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris piles visible near the structure.
• Thin scattered shrubs around the perimeter of the structure to increase open space between plants and the building.
• Cut back ground vegetation growing directly against the foundation and walls.
• Trim any shrubs or low branches along the driveway to keep the travel path clear for vehicles.
• Remove dead or dry material from brush areas closest to the structure.
• Keep shrubs in the brush areas nearest the house separated from each other so fire cannot easily move between plants toward the structure.
• Clear woody debris from the area surrounding any outbuildings or secondary structures on the property.
• Maintain the long driveway free of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs along its full length to allow emergency vehicle access.
• Remove accumulated dead leaves, sticks, and plant debris from the ground around the base of the structure.
• Keep the area immediately around the house clear of stacked wood, debris, or dried plant material.
